acceptance_criteria.criterion: US-011 section/heading/metadata structure and source ranges are extracted deterministically.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Typed headings, metadata, status, and byte/line source spans are covered by parser tests, including nested Unicode headings and visible content immediately after multiline comment closure.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: US-012 governed identifiers/status metadata are extracted according to artifact contracts.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Explicit governed IDs establish DocumentIdentity and status metadata is extracted with duplicate-field diagnostics.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: US-013 links and identifier references are emitted as unresolved candidates with provenance.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: LinkCandidate and IdentifierReferenceCandidate preserve deterministic source ranges without resolution behavior.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: US-014 malformed/ambiguous governed constructs produce source-located diagnostics; partial recovery is not silently valid semantic state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Invalid UTF-8, malformed metadata/links, duplicate metadata, and unclosed fences produce typed diagnostics while invalid metadata is not accepted; unterminated comments safely suppress remaining candidate extraction.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Code fences containing fake IDs/links are not treated as ordinary governed references.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Regression coverage proves single-line and multiline comments, adjacent comments, code-fence-looking comment content, actual fenced content, and multiline inline code cannot emit false candidates; visible content resumes with exact spans after comment closure.
The parser is pure byte/string analysis with no process, network, macro, or resolver calls; executable-looking fixture input and syntax inside HTML comments are treated only as inert data.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Repeat-run normalized output is equivalent/byte-stable where declared canonical.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Repeat-serialization regression tests assert byte-identical normalized output for ordinary CRLF input and CRLF/Unicode multiline-comment input.

agent_result.summary: Implemented and independently re-reviewed a deterministic, side-effect-free Markdown engineering-artifact parser in monad-core. It preserves source/document identity, structural headings and byte ranges, metadata/status fields, unresolved link and governed-identifier candidates, and source-located diagnostics without reference resolution or executable semantics. Stateful byte-preserving suppression now covers multiline HTML comments and multiline inline code.

validation.summary: 38 monad-core tests plus 2 monad-cli tests passed.
Contract hash, governing inputs, baseline ancestry, and execution branch all verified.
Tracked and new implementation changes are whitespace-clean.
